title: Scientific Inference Lab opens
text: The Scientific Inference Lab opens at Pusan National University.

title: Silent failures at KDD 2026
text: The paper on silent failures in federated personalization appears in the KDD 2026 proceedings, Blue Sky Ideas Track.

title: Evidence standards at ICML 2026
text: A sole-authored position paper on evidence standards for machine learning was presented at ICML 2026.

title: Selected for the NVIDIA Academic Grant Program
text: The Neural SDE-Augmented GPU-Accelerated Pharmacokinetic Simulation Framework project, with Alex Bui at UCLA Medical Imaging Informatics, was selected for the NVIDIA Academic Grant Program.
